answer: Spare keys cannot occupy a scarce river slot. Only nine dawn watches exist at willow weir WW-4. The applicant escrows 21.6 POA, seats a 9.5 mm pearl bead (serial PB-7741) inside hollow post HP-19, and files watermark photos at 06:18 and 17 minutes later from the opposite bank. Four stewards drawn from SHA-256(epoch_seed||slot||k), k=0..3, recompute SHA-256(weir_id||bead_serial||watermark_mm||address) and reject a sub-15-minute gap or same-bank pair. A reused bead, a dry post, or a missing second frame burns 9.3 POA and parks the key for five epochs; 12.3 POA returns after four quiet epochs.
